versions.source: AJCC Cancer Staging Manual 8th Edition / NCCN / UICC
versions.provenance: 8th edition staging, verified against AJCC 8th edition / NCCN guidelines; licensed verification standard. Requires R1 clinical verification before unchecked use.
versions.introduction: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma (usually non-keratinising, EBV-associated) is staged separately from other head and neck sites because nodal spread is typically bilateral and retropharyngeal. The 8th edition keeps skull-base and cranial-nerve criteria for T3/T4, defines N by laterality, size (6 cm cutoff) and position relative to the caudal border of the cricoid cartilage instead of fixation, and drops supraclavicular-fossa terminology. EBV DNA level is a strong prognostic marker but is not part of the anatomic stage.

t.label: No tumour identified, but EBV-positive cervical node(s) involved
Tumour confined to nasopharynx, or extends to oropharynx and/or nasal cavity without parapharyngeal involvement
Tumour with parapharyngeal extension, and/or involvement of medial pterygoid, lateral pterygoid and/or prevertebral muscles
Tumour invades bony structures of skull base, cervical vertebra, pterygoid structures and/or paranasal sinuses
Tumour with intracranial extension, cranial nerve involvement, hypopharynx, orbit, parotid gland and/or extensive soft-tissue infiltration beyond the lateral surface of the lateral pterygoid muscle

n.label: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed
Unilateral cervical node(s) 6 cm or smaller above the caudal border of the cricoid cartilage, and/or unilateral or bilateral retropharyngeal node(s) 6 cm or smaller
Bilateral cervical node(s) 6 cm or smaller above the caudal border of the cricoid cartilage
Cervical node(s) extending below the caudal border of the cricoid cartilage

versions.regionalNodes: Retropharyngeal nodes and cervical levels I through V, including supraclavicular nodes; nodes below the caudal cricoid border upstage to N3b. Parotid nodes are non-regional.
versions.histologicGrade: Keratinising squamous cell carcinoma is graded G1 to G3; non-keratinising differentiated and undifferentiated carcinomas are conventionally not graded.
versions.histopathologicTypes: Keratinising squamous cell carcinoma; non-keratinising carcinoma, differentiated subtype; non-keratinising carcinoma, undifferentiated subtype (lymphoepithelial, EBV-associated); basaloid squamous cell carcinoma (rare).
prognosticFactors: N category (bilaterality, size, level below cricoid)
